topics.label: Clone repository from remote
topics.why: Clone is the primary entry point for obtaining a repository; understanding its flow reveals transport, storage, and reference setup.
topics.how_question: How does the clone operation fetch objects and references from a remote and initialize local storage?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer modify clone to support a new transport protocol or authentication method?

topics.label: Push commits to remote
topics.why: Push is a core write operation; understanding it reveals pack generation, reference updates, and error handling.
topics.how_question: How does the push operation select objects, generate a packfile, and update remote references?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change push to support a new refspec or atomic push?

topics.label: Fetch objects from remote
topics.why: Fetch is essential for incremental updates; understanding it reveals negotiation, packfile reception, and object storage.
topics.how_question: How does the fetch operation negotiate with the remote, receive a packfile, and integrate objects into local storage?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change fetch to support shallow or partial fetch?

topics.label: Worktree status computation
topics.why: Status is the most user-visible diff operation; understanding it reveals how the working tree, index, and HEAD are compared.
topics.how_question: How does the worktree compute status by comparing the index, HEAD tree, and working directory?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change status to support new ignore patterns or untracked file detection?

topics.label: Commit creation in worktree
topics.why: Commit is the fundamental write operation; understanding it reveals tree building, object writing, and reference update.
topics.how_question: How does the worktree create a commit by building a tree from the index, writing objects, and updating HEAD?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change commit to support signing or custom author information?

topics.label: Reference resolution and expansion
topics.why: References are central to all Git operations; understanding resolution reveals how symbolic refs, peeled refs, and HEAD are handled.
topics.how_question: How does the repository resolve a reference name to an object hash, including symbolic and peeled references?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change reference resolution to support new ref backends or caching?

topics.label: Object storage and retrieval
topics.why: Object storage is the backbone of Git; understanding it reveals how objects are read, written, cached, and packed.
topics.how_question: How does the storage layer read, write, and cache Git objects across loose and packed formats?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change object storage to support a new object format or compression?

topics.label: Packfile scanning and indexing
topics.why: Packfiles are the efficient storage format; understanding scanning reveals how objects are located and decompressed.
topics.how_question: How does the pack scanner locate and decompress objects using pack, index, and reverse index files?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change pack scanning to support multi-pack index or new delta formats?

topics.label: Remote protocol handshake
topics.why: The handshake establishes capabilities and authentication; understanding it reveals protocol version negotiation and transport abstraction.
topics.how_question: How does the transport layer perform a handshake with a remote, negotiate capabilities, and authenticate?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change the handshake to support a new protocol version or authentication method?

topics.label: Configuration loading and merging
topics.why: Configuration affects all operations; understanding loading reveals how system, global, and local configs are merged.
topics.how_question: How does the library load and merge configuration from system, global, and local files?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change configuration loading to support new config scopes or file formats?

topics.label: Submodule initialization and status
topics.why: Submodules are a common but complex feature; understanding them reveals recursive repository handling.
topics.how_question: How does the submodule operation initialize a submodule and compute its status relative to the parent repository?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change submodule handling to support recursive operations or new URL schemes?

topics.label: Blame annotation computation
topics.why: Blame is a performance-sensitive feature; understanding it reveals how history traversal and line mapping work.
topics.how_question: How does the blame algorithm traverse commits and map lines to their origin?
topics.change_question: Where and how should an engineer change blame to support rename detection or performance optimization?

func main() {
	CheckArgs("<url>", "<directory>")
	url, directory := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]

	authMethod, err := ssh.NewSSHAgentAuth("git")
	CheckIfError(err)

	Info("git clone %s ", url)

	r, err := git.PlainClone(directory, &git.CloneOptions{
		URL:      url,
		Progress: os.Stdout,
		ClientOptions: []client.Option{
			client.WithSSHAuth(authMethod),
		},
	})
	CheckIfError(err)
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	ref, err := r.Head()
	CheckIfError(err)
	commit, err := r.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
	CheckIfError(err)

	fmt.Println(commit)
}

func (s *RepositorySuite) TestCloneDeep() {
	fs := memfs.New()
	r, _ := Init(memory.NewStorage(), WithWorkTree(fs))
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	head, err := r.Head()
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)
	s.Nil(head)

	err = r.clone(context.Background(), &CloneOptions{
		URL: s.GetBasicLocalRepositoryURL(),
	})

	s.NoError(err)

	remotes, err := r.Remotes()
	s.NoError(err)
	s.Len(remotes, 1)

	head, err = r.Reference(plumbing.HEAD, false)
	s.NoError(err)
	s.NotNil(head)
	s.Equal(plumbing.SymbolicReference, head.Type())
	s.Equal("refs/heads/master", head.Target().String())

	branch, err := r.Reference(head.Target(), false)
	s.NoError(err)
	s.NotNil(branch)
	s.Equal("6ecf0ef2c2dffb796033e5a02219af86ec6584e5", branch.Hash().String())

	branch, err = r.Reference("refs/remotes/origin/master", false)
	s.NoError(err)
	s.NotNil(branch)
	s.Equal(plumbing.HashReference, branch.Type())
	s.Equal("6ecf0ef2c2dffb796033e5a02219af86ec6584e5", branch.Hash().String())

	fi, err := fs.ReadDir("")
	s.NoError(err)
	s.Len(fi, 8)
}

func (s *RepositorySuite) TestCloneConfig() {
	r, _ := Init(memory.NewStorage())
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	head, err := r.Head()
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)
	s.Nil(head)

	err = r.clone(context.Background(), &CloneOptions{
		URL: s.GetBasicLocalRepositoryURL(),
	})

	s.NoError(err)

	cfg, err := r.Config()
	s.NoError(err)

	s.True(cfg.Core.IsBare)
	s.Len(cfg.Remotes, 1)
	s.Equal("origin", cfg.Remotes["origin"].Name)
	s.Len(cfg.Remotes["origin"].URLs, 1)
	s.Len(cfg.Branches, 1)
	s.Equal("master", cfg.Branches["master"].Name)
}

func (s *RemoteSuite) TestPushDeleteReference() {
	fs, err := fixtures.Basic().One().DotGit(fixtures.WithTargetDir(s.T().TempDir))
	s.Require().NoError(err)
	sto := filesystem.NewStorage(fs, cache.NewObjectLRUDefault())
	defer func() { _ = sto.Close() }()

	r, err := PlainClone(s.T().TempDir(), &CloneOptions{
		URL:  fs.Root(),
		Bare: true,
	})
	s.Require().NoError(err)
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	remote, err := r.Remote(DefaultRemoteName)
	s.NoError(err)

	err = remote.Push(&PushOptions{
		RefSpecs: []config.RefSpec{":refs/heads/branch"},
	})
	s.NoError(err)

	_, err = sto.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/branch"))
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)

	_, err = r.Storer.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/branch"))
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)
}

func (s *RemoteSuite) TestForcePushDeleteReference() {
	fs, err := fixtures.Basic().One().DotGit(fixtures.WithTargetDir(s.T().TempDir))
	s.Require().NoError(err)

	sto := filesystem.NewStorage(fs, cache.NewObjectLRUDefault())
	defer func() { _ = sto.Close() }()

	r, err := PlainClone(s.T().TempDir(), &CloneOptions{
		URL:  fs.Root(),
		Bare: true,
	})
	s.Require().NoError(err)
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	remote, err := r.Remote(DefaultRemoteName)
	s.NoError(err)

	err = remote.Push(&PushOptions{
		RefSpecs: []config.RefSpec{":refs/heads/branch"},
		Force:    true,
	})
	s.NoError(err)

	_, err = sto.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/branch"))
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)

	_, err = r.Storer.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/branch"))
	s.ErrorIs(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound)

func (s *RemoteSuite) TestPushRejectNonFastForward() {
	fs, err := fixtures.Basic().One().DotGit(fixtures.WithTargetDir(s.T().TempDir))
	s.Require().NoError(err)

	server := filesystem.NewStorage(fs, cache.NewObjectLRUDefault())
	defer func() { _ = server.Close() }()

	r, err := PlainClone(s.T().TempDir(), &CloneOptions{URL: fs.Root(), Bare: true})
	s.Require().NoError(err)
	defer func() { _ = r.Close() }()

	remote, err := r.Remote(DefaultRemoteName)
	s.Require().NoError(err)

	branch := plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/branch")
	oldRef, err := server.Reference(branch)
	s.NoError(err)
	s.NotNil(oldRef)

	err = remote.Push(&PushOptions{RefSpecs: []config.RefSpec{
		"refs/heads/master:refs/heads/branch",
	}})
	s.ErrorContains(err, "non-fast-forward update: refs/heads/branch")

	newRef, err := server.Reference(branch)
	s.NoError(err)
	s.Equal(oldRef, newRef)
}
